text:
alex: heads up — vendor portal still shows our APAC credit as pending, but the billing email says it cleared. our h100 reserved quota isn't bumped.
maria: ugh, same. trying to run canary this afternoon, need a small mix of h100 + a500. if quota doesn't show we can't start canary.
sam: pinged vendor rep (ticket #9843). they said backend processing has a 24h lag after invoice apply. no ETA beyond that.
thomas: can we short-circuit by swapping SKU mix to include more a500s for the canary? perf won't match prod but will validate routing + autoscale.
alex: yeah that's my thought. canary only needs ~4 GPUs for 2 hours. willing to accept different perf profile.
maria: ok — who's doing the quick terraform edit? I can patch repro configs and run smoke.
sam: I can push a tiny TF change. patch: `resource "redwood_gpu_pool" "canary" { count = 1 sku = "a500" size = 4 burst = true }` — will keep h100 lines commented so we can revert.
thomas: also let's add fallback routing rule: if h100 quota == 0 route to a500-canary to avoid errors. small snippet in routing: `prefer: [h100, a500] fallback: a500`.
alex: procurement-bot — any way to force-apply the credit so quota reflects immediately? :pray:
procurement-bot: Invoice #INV-2026 applied. Backend sync started — estimated 6-12h. If urgent, request a manual refresh via vendor support portal (link: https://vendor.example/ticket/9843).
maria: thanks. given that, plan: sam will flip TF to a500 for the 2h canary window, thomas will add fallback routing, i will run smoke and report perf deltas. alex will follow up with vendor rep for manual refresh.
alex: timeline: change + deploy in next 30m, smoke at T+45, report by T+90. any objections?
sam: no objections. i'll open a rollback PR immediately after deploy so it's easier to revert.
thomas: I'll add a health-check alert to the canary route in case latency jumps >30%.
maria: perfect. tagging @oncall in case autoscaling weirdness pops up.
alex: cheers — keep updates in this thread and paste the PR links when ready. :thumbsup:
